title: [P1.1] Expo skeleton, Jest (Europe/Warsaw), time utilities
body:
Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-01-domain-core.md — Task 1

- create-expo-app (blank-typescript), jest-expo, cross-env TZ
- `src/domain/time.ts`: dilatoDay (04:00 boundary), addDays, minutesBetween, addMinutes, atLocalTime
- Tests incl. DST 2026-10-25

title: [P1.2] Delay ladder + domain errors
body:
Plan 1 — Task 2

- Ladder m15…h24 incl. noon/evening, hidden < 15 min before cutoff
- Custom 15–1440 min, step 5
- DomainError codes

title: [P1.3] Habit profiles + daily suggestion
body:
Plan 1 — Task 3

- First suggestion 30 min for all profiles
- Step up after 2 successes at the same step (3 if > 20 cigs/day)
- Interrupted → same step + one lower alternative; never below 30 by default

title: [P1.4] Challenge state machine
body:
Plan 1 — Task 4

- running → achieved (derived) → overtime ↔ achieved → completed; running → interrupted
- Overtime blocks 15/30/60 from the tap; rollover at 04:00; 'Nadal trwa?' confirmation
- liveResultMinutes, clockProgress, canStartToday

title: [P1.5] Smoke-free clock + body benefits
body:
Plan 1 — Task 5

- smokeFreeMinutes, longest, default morning answer
- 10 body-benefit thresholds, unlocked/next with progress

title: [P1.6] Statistics: streak, record, average, savings, timeline
body:
Plan 1 — Task 6

- Morning streak (active days), record, 7-day average
- Savings ≈ minutes × cigs/960 × price per cigarette; time regained
- S12 timeline rows (success/record/interrupted/empty)

title: [P1.7] Badges + celebration tier
body:
Plan 1 — Task 7

- 16 threshold (9 earnable in MVP) + 6 attitude badges = 22
- newBadges, isNewRecord (repeatable), celebrationTier small/medium/large

title: [P1.8] Domain public API, purity guard, coverage gate
body:
Plan 1 — Task 8

- index.ts barrel, purity test (no React/IO/clock), coverage ≥95% lines / ≥85% branches
- Update CLAUDE.md + roadmap status
